text:
oliver_csm: Quick sync — Northpine renewal needs 1) final signature, 2) split invoicing for EMEA, 3) SSO enablement slot. Sales says PO incoming but legal flagged term change.

jake_ae: PO noted, thanks. Can we get signature by Fri? They want 9-month term instead of 12.

maria_legal: Heads up — 9mo requires pricing recalc and approvals from contracts. I can approve with a 5% surcharge for short term. Need to see redline.

oliver_csm: Understood. Customer asked for prorated seat add-on too. I'll attach draft amendment in a sec.

emma_fin: For split invoicing to EMEA, billing needs VAT business ID and remittance details. Customer contact: lucy@northpine.com

ops-bot: Ticket #CS-9987 created for onboarding SSO. Scheduled window: 2024-08-11 15:00 UTC.

jake_ae: Lucy confirmed PO will be sent today, but legal wants the 9mo language changed to "initial term" rather than "term". Maria — can you draft the amendment line for that?

maria_legal: Drafted, pasted below — please review:
```
Amendment: The Initial Term shall be nine (9) months commencing on the Effective Date. Following the Initial Term, the Agreement will automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods unless either party provides written notice.
```

oliver_csm: Looks good. Jake — share with Lucy and ask for signature on DocuSign. I'll track onboarding readiness: SSO config, seat provisioning, and kickoff docs.

jake_ae: Sent DocuSign (https://dscy.mn/abcdef) to Lucy. Also asked for VAT and remittance in same thread. :crossed_fingers: 

emma_fin: Once signed, I'll split invoice: 60% EMEA net30, 40% US net45. Confirm bank details before issuing.

lucy_northpine: (from customer) Received amendment, will sign today. VAT number attached: GB999999973.

oliver_csm: Great — I'm marking this as low-to-medium risk. Notes: follow up in 48h if DocuSign isn't completed, and schedule enablement after signature. :white_check_mark: 

jake_ae: Noted. Closing loop here, will update with signed PDF.

ops-bot: Reminder: SSO ticket CS-9987 assigned to eng-iam, ETA 48 hours.
